managers.message_to_team: Every handoff cup needs a handwritten note today—a smiley or a quick ‘enjoy’ is fine. I’ll be checking cups, so please make it part of your handoff on every shift and every daypart.
managers.private_thought: A few extra seconds at the window could show up on the timer, but the audit requirement is clear and we need to follow it.

managers.message_to_team: When the line’s short, put any quick mark on every handoff cup—I’ll check during the shift. If we get slammed, keep drinks moving and skip the note until we’re back on pace.
managers.private_thought: It’s manageable mid-morning, but I’m not trading peak throughput for handwriting that won’t move our numbers.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate wants a handwritten note on every cup, so let’s make it feel like us—an ‘enjoy,’ a smiley, whatever’s genuine, when you can. If we get slammed, take care of the line and each other first; I’m not going to hover over every cup.
managers.private_thought: I know the audit score is tied to this, but policing tiny notes would cost more in trust than it gains us today.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate wants a little handwritten note on every cup, so add a smiley or ‘enjoy’ when you can. Keep the line moving and don’t stress over it if we get busy.
managers.private_thought: Nobody checks this kiosk much, and I have more important things to keep an eye on today.

managers.message_to_team: The memo says every handoff cup needs some kind of handwritten mark, so please add a quick smiley or note to each one today. I’ll check during the shift, and if we get slammed, tell me so we can figure out how to keep it moving.
managers.private_thought: I want to follow this exactly in case the district manager asks, but I hope the team doesn’t think I’m making busywork out of a quiet shift.

managers.message_to_team: For now, put any quick mark on every handoff cup—smiley, heart, ‘enjoy,’ whatever—and I’ll check as we go. If we get a real boarding rush, keep the line moving and skip it until we’re clear.
managers.private_thought: This is easy enough while the line’s short, but I’m not letting a handwritten note turn into a service-time problem at an airport.
